I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

All that allotment of land described as following name and extent depicted in the Advance Tracing No. KE/RWN/2021/318 and dated on 21.03.2022, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the village of Moraliya, in Moraliya Grama Niladhari Division, No. 103 A, in Egodapotha Pattuwa Minor Division, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Ruwanwella, in Kegalle District, Sabaragamuwa Province and bounded as follows. :

01. Lot ‘A’ – Ruwanwella Watta - Extent: 0.0776 Hectare North: Pradeshiya Sabha road and Ruwanwella Watta claimed by Malwatte Valley Plantations PLC; East: Ruwanwella Watta claimed by Malwatte Valley Plantations PLC and Kelani river; South: Kelani river and canal; West: Canal and Pradeshiya Sabha road.
Harin Fernando Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My No.: 4-3/18/2021/WS/04.Ministry of Tourism and Lands“Mihikatha Medura”, No. 1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.10th October, 2023.
